description: The SIMT MCP server registry. Hand-authored, like the skill registry: structure is declared, never inferred. A server entry is data about an external process - how to reach it (transport) and when a task needs it (capabilities) - not the process itself. Selection reuses the skill scoring, so a server is offered for exactly the same reasons a skill would be (docs/research/0002-simt-dev-cli.md section 3.1).

servers.name: simt-dev
servers.summary: The simt-dev tool surface over MCP: brief packets, plan next and done, gate checks, the skill registry, and review verdicts as read-only tools. Connect when a task plans slices, checks gates, or resolves skills through simt-dev.
